acceptanceCriteria: A consumer recomputes the plan, approval and raw-report digests from retained artifacts alone, with a conformance fixture that does it.

Missing, tampered or stale plan, approval, raw report, assertion outcome, setup, unrelated, cleanup or bound evidence reports invalid_control, not_run or not_supported, never killed, each with a test.
The receipt schema is versioned, bounded under BBF-V0-010, deterministic, and screened for credentials and undeclared environment values; BBF-V0 amends BBF-V0-002 for the new bindings.
body: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/167 (adopter integration against the installed 0.8.0 companion). Checked against internal/behaviorfalsify/types.go at 2a8d1ec: the Report binds plan_digest and each AttemptResult keeps the parsed HookReceipt (plan_digest, target/runner identity, attempt/retry, native_receipt_sha256, target/unrelated/setup observations, artifacts), hook and cleanup process evidence and workspace before/after digests. Missing: an approval record distinct from the plan digest (Execute takes approvedDigest as a bare string), the raw hook-receipt bytes with their digest, canonical plan bytes or a documented recompute path, the companion's own tool/schema/revision identity, and an explicit list of omitted or unsupported fields. Companion work under proposed/experimental BBF-V0; post-1.0 per decision 0381 item 9 (not a Core-verb correctness failure).
title: behaviorfalsify: approval-bound receipt that retains raw hook-report bytes and names omitted fields (issue #167)
